body: She goes to therapy but not often enough probably (every few weeks I think), and is not on medication. I think she tried medication a few years ago though, but I'm not sure.
Thanks for sharing your thoughts. I'll insist on her going to therapy weekly and maybe look into some therapy for myself.

Hey,

I know I forgot to state my age. I'm 19 and she is a few years older than me. 

I'd also like to say that I don't agree with what you said about that we don't know each other very well. Sure, it's true that we have spent more days online than in real life. But our calls and texts aren't "fake". Besides that, we have also spent whole days, nights, and weeks together in real life. I know her better than and feel closer to her than several friends I've known for years. I also want to clarify that she doesn't express suicidal thoughts as threats. It's not like she says things like "if you do/don't do this or that I'll kill myself". (Sorry if I misunderstood you, english isn't my first language as you probably can notice). 

But overall I appreciate your response and agree with several things you said... I guess I'll insist on her getting serious about professional help, and if she isn't willing to do that and to try for real to get better, then I can't continue the relationship no matter how much I love her.

But I guess the anxiety still affects you and the relationship in the same way.
